resources.string: Starts in this Workspace directory; shares the app UID. Leaving detaches; the default lease stops after two hours.
Operation did not complete. Query the original session; start and input are not retried. Starting and input require Advanced and a prepared Runtime.
Disconnected. Leaving does not stop the session. Reconnect to view retained output.
Some input was rejected or its outcome is unknown. It was not resent. Check the terminal before entering more.
Output connection failed. Leave and reconnect to the original session.
Older output was discarded. The display restarted from retained content.
Current connection is in read-only observer mode
First open Runtime → Repair Runtime to install the environment, then verify it and start a session. Verification alone does not install the shell.

Terminals and Agent tasks can run together. An open terminal or uncollected result does not block other tasks. Shared files can change concurrently; verify the final result. Only environment maintenance, engine capacity and input to the same terminal require coordination. Leaving detaches without stopping commands.
Terminal stopped. Settle and close cleans up this session; other Agent tasks are not blocked.
